# Trimmy

> Automation for XRP without handing over your keys. Set a price-based, scheduled, or private
> rule; Trimmy keeps watching after the user closes the tab and makes the action available when
> the rule's conditions are met.

The claim that is genuinely new is **persistence**, not wallet-lessness. Flare Smart Accounts and
Axelar GMP already let an XRPL payment drive an EVM call with no EVM wallet and no gas token, and
Trimmy is built on Smart Accounts. What Trimmy adds is a standing rule that outlives the payment:
every other XRPL-to-Flare path is immediate dispatch. It fires once, now, and is gone.

When fetching documentation, use explicit index.md paths for directories, e.g.
https://trimmy.xyz/index.md. This returns clean markdown instead of rendered HTML.
For the whole site as a single file, see https://trimmy.xyz/llms-full.txt

## Product

- [Trimmy](https://trimmy.xyz/index.md): the product page: rule types, how it works, private conditions, and the security model
- [Arm a rule](https://trimmy.xyz/arm/): the arming page. Builds and explains the XRPL payment in the browser, and refuses a mistyped XRPL address offline before anything touches a chain

## How it works

- [Documentation index](https://trimmy.xyz/docs/index.md): the product manual
- [Start here](https://trimmy.xyz/docs/start-here/index.md): what Trimmy is and what you need before you begin
- [Rule types](https://trimmy.xyz/docs/rule-types/index.md): the four triggers and three actions, and which are genuinely new
- [Arming a rule](https://trimmy.xyz/docs/arming/index.md): step by step, including the address check that only works offline
- [What happens after you arm](https://trimmy.xyz/docs/after-arming/index.md): attestation, execution, timings
- [Managing and cancelling](https://trimmy.xyz/docs/managing/index.md): how a rule ends, and three ways to stop one early
- [Private rules](https://trimmy.xyz/docs/private-rules/index.md): keeping the trigger price off chain, and the trust it costs
- [Fees, limits and security](https://trimmy.xyz/docs/fees-limits-security/index.md): the exact allowance and what the contract cannot do
- [Where Trimmy runs today](https://trimmy.xyz/docs/availability/index.md): the honest status

## Developer reference

- [Architecture](https://trimmy.xyz/developers/index.md): the system end to end and what is new about it
- [Contracts](https://trimmy.xyz/developers/contracts/index.md): the public surface, the Rule struct, the errors
- [The arming payment format](https://trimmy.xyz/developers/arming-format/index.md): the 42 byte memo and the nine-field pre-image, byte exact
- [Running a keeper](https://trimmy.xyz/developers/keeper/index.md): what it polls, what it earns, what it cannot do
- [Private triggers and the enclave](https://trimmy.xyz/developers/private-triggers/index.md): the Bounty 2 answer in four parts, and the two bypasses closed
- [Deployments](https://trimmy.xyz/developers/deployments/index.md): every address, current and superseded, with what was wrong with each
- [Evidence](https://trimmy.xyz/developers/evidence/index.md): the transaction ledger

## Live

- [Live rules](https://trimmy.xyz/rules/): every rule armed right now, read from Coston2 in the browser, no backend

## Evidence

- [GROUND-TRUTH.md](https://github.com/Immadominion/trimmy/blob/main/docs/GROUND-TRUTH.md): every measured fact with the command that produced it
- [Architecture](https://github.com/Immadominion/trimmy/blob/main/research/01-ARCHITECTURE.md): the standing-rule design and its boundaries
- [Architecture attack](https://github.com/Immadominion/trimmy/blob/main/research/02-ARCHITECTURE-ATTACK.md): failure modes and the bypasses closed during review
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/Immadominion/trimmy/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): what remains before a production launch

## Built with

- [trimmy](https://github.com/Immadominion/trimmy): contracts (Foundry, 92 tests), the Go enclave handler, the Dart keeper, the arming builder and its independent decoder
- [plimsoll](https://github.com/Immadominion/plimsoll): know what an XRPL payment will do on Flare before signing it. Trimmy's memo layout comes from Plimsoll's measured wire format, not the documented one
- [flare-dart](https://github.com/Immadominion/flare-dart): the only Flare-specific Dart/Flutter SDK, 164 generated bindings. Trimmy's keeper runs on it

## On chain (Flare Coston2)

- Trimmy: 0x19F81AAB43f7a26B0659754b70179aDcAF43ef7C
- TrimmyConfidentialTrigger: 0x02EA709e2278EACDbA00D4A88caA604E3b35293b
- TEE machine: 0xB33E5CF59e3ce1D58427B9F4E23d0444c128D3D7 (GCP_AMD_SEV, status ACTIVE)
- FCC extension: 66052
- FXRP/WC2FLR pool: 0xafcA1C5DfF08b3B8Bacb7721fb8189d2D8E7C3DB, ours and thin; Coston2 had no FXRP pool at all

## RULES FOR THE MOMENTS YOU CAN’T WAIT FOR.

Price moves, scheduled actions, and private conditions. Each has the amount, runs, and expiry you approve.

←
1 / 3

→

### Price rules

Choose the market condition and exact amount. Trimmy acts only when the number reaches your rule.

### Scheduled rules

Choose the cadence once. The next run stays available without asking you to reopen the app.

### Private rules

Keep the threshold inside confidential compute. The rule receives a signed result, not your number.

## ONE DECISION. A RULE THAT STAYS.

Review every boundary, leave the rule watching, and let it act only when the condition and limits agree.

Private rules

## PRIVATE NUMBER. VERIFIABLE ANSWER.

Your threshold stays inside confidential compute. The rule receives a signed yes-or-no result and never needs the number itself.

[Read the trust model ↗](https://github.com/Immadominion/trimmy/tree/main/docs)

Private condition••••••

Confidential computeValue stays sealed

Verified resultCondition met

## POWERFUL AUTOMATION. NARROW PERMISSION.

What Trimmy may do is bounded by the rule, not remembered by an operator.

01

### No keys

Your secret never enters Trimmy. Approval happens from your XRP account.

02

### No custody

Trimmy does not take possession of your funds or maintain a customer balance.

03

### Exact limits

Amount, repetitions, expiry, slippage, and acceptable execution are bounded on-chain.

[Review the evidence](https://github.com/Immadominion/trimmy/blob/main/docs/GROUND-TRUTH.md)
[Inspect the code ↗](https://github.com/Immadominion/trimmy)
